description.value:
Where some operatives rely purely on blade and blaster, Beguiler Practice adepts weaponize charisma itself, drawing on a faint current of the Force to color perception and plant suggestion. They talk their way past guards who never saw a reason to stop them, and turn a target's own confidence against it.

These operatives thrive on misdirection: a warm smile, a convincing lie, a flicker of Force-born suggestion, all deployed in the instant before the killing blow lands. Their gift is making people believe exactly what serves the mission, right up until it's too late.
